resolution.note: ci-poll.ts PreToolUse hook refuses gh watch and sleep+gh loops, names krn ci wait

title: Refuse CI polling loops in lead Bash in favour of krn ci wait
body:
Outcome: lead sessions stop polling CI with sleep loops, gh run watch or python loops; one blocking `bin/krn ci wait` per PR.
Why: ~224 polling calls, 265 turns, 5.8% of lead dollars since 2026-11-08, at the highest context (95k median) (.krn/runs/roadmap-refill-3/session-cost.md).
Proof: a PreToolUse Bash refusal (beside scripts/claude/piped-check.ts) names `bin/krn ci wait` when a command polls gh in a loop or with sleep; measure polling calls on 10 new sessions.
Scope: scripts/claude, .claude/settings.json, their tests.
